verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Open my eyes to see
The wonderful mystery of love
Forming into You
I’m drawn to the gravity of love

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
We’re standing still in a moment of eternity
Where worlds collide
And I feel the breath of heaven over me

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
My soul sings
My soul sings
My soul sings
How I love You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Open the page and see
The wonderful history of love
I start and end with You
I’m pulled by the gravity of love

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
It’s just a little while longer and I’ll see You
It’s just a little while longer and I’ll know You
It’s just a little while longer and we’ll be together

verse.name: o2
verse.lines:
All I want is just to know Your heart
And would You keep me here until we’re one

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
It’s just a little while longer and I’ll see You
It’s just a little while longer and I’ll know You
It’s just a little while longer and we’ll stand before You
